verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference and training platform. An AI-insights feature (for example, over usage or account data in the console) is a fair axis for it, but the evidence documents no such in-product feature. What it does document are developer building blocks: chat, structured-output and function-calling APIs that a developer could use to build insight generation over their own data. Building blocks earn no credit for this story, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
